subtitle: Amapuzzle ezindlela zenombolo
short_description: Beka ku-1 kuya ku-16 ngendlela lapho inombolo ngayinye ithinta eyilandelayo.
description:
Beka izinombolo ezingu-1 kuya ku-16 egridini ye-4×4, inombolo ngayinye kanye kuphela, ukuze zonke izinombolo ezilandelanayo zithinte ngokuqondile, ngokuthi phansi noma ngokuchezuka. Izinombolo ezinikeziwe kumelwe zihlale lapho zikhona.

Thepha iseli elishintshekayo bese ukhetha inombolo ku-keypad. Ukusula kukhipha iseli.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
